head: ef90f6b681dbcd8ae7316cf5f2c5f767c6f9dc36

batches.name: Inspect and audit
changes: Created this progress file and COMPOSER-RELEASE-REPORT.md only.
validation: All six local package composer.json files passed composer validate --strict --no-check-publish.
The subtree split script passed bash -n and --help.
All six GitHub distribution repositories and their main refs were checked read-only.
Packagist package detail metadata was checked read-only for all six package names.

batches.name: Correct packaging issues
changes: Confirmed all six package LICENSE files match the root MIT license and copyright notice.
Confirmed the Core README and corrected CLI installation/export documentation are present.
Declared ext-pdo_sqlite as a CLI development requirement for its in-memory SQLite test.
Updated the split publisher to create annotated tags and reject existing lightweight tags.
Pinned the release shell script to LF so it runs from a Windows checkout.
validation: All six Composer manifests passed strict validation.
CLI package tests, Core tests, PHP smoke checks, and both Laravel Testbench suites passed.
Annotated tag object creation and push were verified against an isolated local bare repository.

batches.name: Validate packages and prepare distribution updates
changes: Commits 8859a6d and b4fd543 are now included in synchronized origin/main; no distribution release was pushed.
Previewed all six subtree split commits from a clean isolated clone.
Verified every current distribution main is an ancestor of its proposed split commit.
validation: All six split trees passed the release script's tree and content preflight.
All six source-to-distribution mappings were confirmed, including PHP client to multikey-auth-php-client.
Packagist source URLs and current dev-main metadata were checked for all six packages.

batches.name: Prepare stable release commits and tags
batches.notes: After explicit user approval, all six packages were released at v1.0.0 in dependency order using the existing subtree publisher. No force-push was used.

batches.name: Publish tags and verify Packagist
validation: All six annotated v1.0.0 tag refs and peeled commits were verified with git ls-remote --tags.
Packagist Composer v2 metadata exposes v1.0.0 for all six packages with source references matching their split commits.
All six releases appeared in Packagist after their GitHub tag pushes; the specific webhook/app configuration is not publicly inspectable.

batches.name: Test clean Composer installations and finalize
validation: All six unversioned composer require commands succeeded in clean temporary projects using default stable rules.
All six ^1.0 composer require commands succeeded in clean temporary projects using default stable rules.
Each install selected v1.0.0 and passed a representative Composer autoload class check.
The exact composer require 'proit365/laravel-multikey-auth-server:^1.0' command succeeded and installed its Server/Core dependencies at v1.0.0.
batches.notes: The broader RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md integration and security gates remain open and are not represented as completed by Composer packaging validation.

root_cause: The original install failure occurred because the six distribution repositories had no stable tags and Packagist exposed only dev-main. Stable ^1.0 constraints therefore had no matching versions; the dependency chain also required stable Core and Server releases.

packages/core.validation: composer validate passed; unversioned and ^1.0 clean installs and autoload checks passed

packages/server.validation: composer validate passed; unversioned and ^1.0 clean installs and autoload checks passed

packages/client-php.validation: composer validate passed; unversioned and ^1.0 clean installs and autoload checks passed

packages/laravel-server.validation: composer validate passed; unversioned and ^1.0 clean installs and autoload checks passed; transitive server/core dependencies resolved

packages/laravel-client.validation: composer validate passed; unversioned and ^1.0 clean installs and autoload checks passed

packages/cli.validation: composer validate passed; package test passed; unversioned and ^1.0 clean installs and autoload checks passed

findings: All six annotated v1.0.0 tags and peeled commits were verified on their intended GitHub distribution repositories.
Packagist Composer v2 metadata exposes v1.0.0 for all six packages with matching source references and declared internal dependencies.
All six unversioned and all six ^1.0 clean Composer installs succeeded with default minimum-stability; each package's representative PSR-4 class autoloaded.
The exact Laravel Server ^1.0 require command succeeded and resolved stable Server and Core dependencies automatically.
The PHP client split is correctly mapped to proit365/multikey-auth-php-client; never push it to the monorepo repository.
The existing parent update.bat stages broadly and pushes the monorepo and package splits without test or stable-version gates; it was inspected but not run.
Server and PHP client have no package-local Composer test scripts or dev test dependencies; use the monorepo test suite as a release gate or confirm whether portable package tests are required.

The broader release checklist still has live integration/concurrency tests, an independent security review, protected-export interoperability, shared production rate limiting, and master-key/secure-export workflow verification outstanding.
Packagist indexing after the pushes was observed; the account's exact GitHub application/webhook configuration is not publicly inspectable.
unverified_or_pending: Exact private Packagist/GitHub app or webhook configuration; observed tag indexing and clean installs confirm updates reached Packagist.

Completion of broader RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md gates: live integration/concurrency, independent security review, protected-export interoperability, shared production rate limiting, and master-key/secure-export workflow verification.
next_action: No further Composer publication action is required for the v1.0.0 acceptance criteria. Address the separately tracked broader release checklist before making additional production/security claims.
